catalogue.source: The live scanner's rules (ADR 022). Every template is watched at once.

groups.label: Stock filter
groups.blurb: Checked when a setup arms, from the Five Pillars read then. Off lets every name the scanner follows through.

params.label: Price at least
params.help: Arm only when the last price is at least this.

params.label: Price at most
params.help: Arm only when the last price is at most this.

params.label: Float at most
params.help: Arm only when the float is at most this many million shares.

params.label: Up on the day at least
params.help: Arm only when the stock is up at least this much from the prior close.

params.label: Relative volume at least
params.help: Arm only when relative volume is at least this.

params.label: Needs a catalyst
params.help: Arm only when the News pillar passes: a real company catalyst since the prior close.

params.label: Grade at least
params.help: Arm only setups graded this well or better.

params.label: A fact Nova does not know passes
params.help: On: an unknown price, float, change or volume does not block the filter. Off: it does.

groups.label: The pattern
groups.blurb: What the bars must show before a setup arms.

params.label: Leg at least
params.help: The leg high is at least this far over the lowest low of the leg window.

params.label: Leg window
params.help: The bars ending at the leg high that the leg is measured over.

params.label: New high over
params.help: The leg high is the highest high of this many bars before it.

params.label: Leg high is the high of day
params.help: The leg high is also the day's high so far, pre-market included.

params.label: Pullback at least
params.help: Fewest candles after the leg high.

params.label: Pullback at most
params.help: Most candles after the leg high before the pullback ran too long.

params.label: Gives back less than
params.help: The pullback's low gives back less than this share of the leg.

params.label: Holds the EMA
params.help: Every pullback candle closes at or above this EMA.

params.label: EMA slack
params.help: A pullback close may sit this far under the EMA.

params.label: MACD histogram above zero
params.help: The last pullback candle's MACD histogram is above zero (the front side of the move).

params.label: Setups a symbol a day
params.help: The first pullback, then the second -- no more on one symbol that day.

groups.label: Entry
groups.blurb: Where the buy goes and when.

params.label: Buy over the pullback high by
params.help: The entry is the last pullback candle's high plus this.

params.label: Arms from
params.help: No setup arms before this time.

params.label: Arms until
params.help: No setup arms, and none triggers, at or after this time.

params.label: Near the trigger within
params.help: Price this close to the trigger is when the tape is read (or the percent below, whichever is wider).

groups.label: Risk and target
groups.blurb: The stop, the risk it allows, the target, and the scoring exit.

params.label: Largest risk a share
params.help: Entry minus the pullback low. A bigger risk skips the setup.

params.label: Smallest risk a share
params.help: A smaller risk skips the setup: the stop would sit in the spread.

params.label: Slippage counted in the risk
params.help: Added to the risk before the two checks above, as the research did.

params.label: Target 1

choices.label: the leg high or R x risk, whichever is higher
a fixed amount over the entry

params.help: Half comes off at target 1 and the stop moves to the entry (the scoring exit).

params.label: R multiple
params.help: Used when target 1 is the leg high or R x risk.

params.label: Fixed target
params.help: Used when target 1 is a fixed amount over the entry.

params.label: Out after
params.help: Scoring exit: this many candles without a close over the entry -> out at the close.

groups.label: Tape gate
groups.blurb: Read from the Level 2 and time and sales when price is near the trigger.

params.label: Looks back
params.help: The book samples and prints the gate reads.

params.label: Book is stale after
params.help: No book newer than this reads blind.

params.label: Widest spread
params.help: A wider spread vetoes (or the percent below, whichever is wider).

params.label: At the level up to
params.help: Ask levels from 1 cent under the trigger to this far over it are at the level.

params.label: Seller that vetoes
params.help: A displayed seller this big at the level vetoes.

params.label: Seller that waits
params.help: A seller this big at the level waits until it thins.

params.label: Thinning means down
params.help: The seller shrank by this much inside the window.

params.label: Green tape needs
params.help: And more volume at the ask than at the bid.

params.label: Hidden seller at
params.help: This much bought at the ask while the ask does not move vetoes.

params.label: Red burst at
params.help: Bid-side volume over this multiple of ask-side volume waits.

groups.label: Five Pillars grade
groups.blurb: Grades every armed setup A / B / C. A pillar Nova does not know never passes.

groups.label: Bot entries at Strategy
groups.blurb: The bot's own rules while this template is in play.

params.label: Bot entries from
params.help: At Strategy the bot sends an entry only inside this window (the venue's clock).

params.label: Bot entries a day
params.help: Entries the bot may send in one venue day.

groups.label: The pattern
groups.blurb: What the bars must show before a setup arms.

params.label: Pole at least
params.help: Consecutive green candles (close over open) ending at the pole top.

params.label: Pole rise at least
params.help: From the pole's lowest low to its highest high (or the dollars below, whichever the pole makes).

params.label: ... or at least
params.help: A pole that rose this many dollars qualifies even under the percent. Off: the percent only.

params.label: Pole volume rising
params.help: The last pole candle trades at least the first's volume (a tiring pole is skipped).

params.label: Flag at least
params.help: Red (or doji) candles after the pole top. One is a micro pullback, not a flag.

params.label: Flag at most
params.help: More red candles than this is too much selling: the setup fails.

params.label: Flag gives back at most
params.help: The flag's low gives back no more than this share of the pole.

params.label: Flag on lighter volume
params.help: The flag's average volume is under the pole's. Heavy selling in the flag is distribution.

params.label: Holds the EMA
params.help: Every flag candle closes at or above this EMA (when the switch below is on).

params.label: EMA slack
params.help: A flag close may sit this far under the EMA.

params.label: Flag closes hold the EMA
params.help: Off: a flag close under the EMA does not fail the setup.

params.label: Flag low near the EMA within
params.help: The material's perfect flag pulls back to the 9 EMA. On: the flag low must come this close to it.

params.label: Skip when the biggest-volume candle is red
params.help: The day's highest-volume candle so far being red means sellers own the day.

params.label: Pole top's upper wick at most
params.help: A big topping tail on the pole's last candle is a caution in the material. Off: no wick check.

params.label: Pole high is the high of day
params.help: On: the pole must set the day's high so far. The material does not ask it.

params.label: MACD histogram above zero
params.help: The last flag candle's MACD histogram is above zero (the front side of the move).

params.label: Flags a symbol a day
params.help: The first and second flag -- the material skips the third.

groups.label: Entry
groups.blurb: Where the buy goes and when.

params.label: Buy over the last flag candle's high by
params.help: The first candle to make a new high trades through it: the entry is that high plus this.

params.label: Arms from
params.help: No flag arms before this time.

params.label: Arms until
params.help: No flag arms, and none triggers, at or after this time.

params.label: Near the trigger within
params.help: Price this close to the trigger is when the tape is read (or the percent below, whichever is wider).

groups.label: Risk and target
groups.blurb: The stop, the risk it allows, the target, and the scoring exit.

params.label: Largest risk a share
params.help: Entry minus the flag low. A bigger risk skips the setup.

params.label: Smallest risk a share
params.help: A smaller risk skips the setup: the stop would sit in the spread.

params.label: Slippage counted in the risk
params.help: Added to the risk before the two checks above, as the research did.

params.label: Target 1

choices.label: the pole high or R x risk, whichever is higher
the pole high (the material's first target)
a fixed amount over the entry

params.help: Half comes off at target 1 and the stop moves to the entry (the scoring exit).

params.label: R multiple
params.help: Used when target 1 is the pole high or R x risk (and when the pole high is not above the entry).

params.label: Fixed target
params.help: Used when target 1 is a fixed amount over the entry.

params.label: Out after
params.help: Scoring exit: this many candles without a close over the entry -> out at the close.

params.label: Impulse at least
params.help: The move into the high of day, over the lowest low of the impulse window.

params.help: The candles ending at the high-of-day candle the impulse is measured over.

params.label: Base at least
params.help: Candles right after the high-of-day candle, none making a new high.

params.label: Base at most
params.help: A longer base is stale: the setup fails.

params.label: Base closes within
params.help: Every base close sits within this of the high of day: a flat top.

params.label: Holds the EMA
params.help: Every base candle's low is at or above this EMA.

params.label: Entry

choices.label: a green candle that holds over the high (the taught way)

params.help: Hold: after the break, buy the close of the first candle whose low holds the high and closes green. Break: buy the break itself.

params.label: Hold must come within
params.help: Hold entry: candles after the break's own candle before the setup disarms.

params.label: Buy over by
params.help: Break: over the high of day by this. Hold: over the hold candle's close by this (the research's cent of slippage).

params.label: Arms from
params.help: No base arms before this time (the research began at 09:30).

params.label: Arms until
params.help: No base arms, and no break triggers, at or after this time.

params.label: Near the trigger within
params.help: Price this close to the trigger is when the tape is read (or the percent below, whichever is wider).

groups.label: Risk and target

params.label: Largest risk a share
params.help: Break: entry minus the base low. Hold: entry minus the hold candle's low. A bigger risk skips the setup.

params.label: Smallest risk a share

params.label: Slippage counted in the risk
params.help: Added to the risk before the two checks above, as the research did.

choices.label: R x risk over the entry (the research's)
a fixed amount over the entry

params.help: Target 1 at R x the risk over the entry.
